name: Register and retain an animal
description: Verifies a complete animal profile can be saved and remains visible.
steps: Add tag GOAT-001, breed Savanna, sex Buck and date of birth
expected: GOAT-001 is visible with Savanna and Buck.

name: Record weight and vaccination email reminder
description: Verifies a vaccination record can include a due date and email reminder settings.
steps: Open Health and add a Vaccination for GOAT-002
Leave automatic email reminders enabled and confirm the reminder email
expected: The vaccination record is saved with its due date and email reminder preference.

name: Track income and expenses
description: Verifies farm money movements can be recorded in the ledger.
expected: Both transactions are visible and the net movement is 7500 KSh.

name: Record mortality and update status
description: Verifies mortality is recorded as an event while the animal history is retained.
steps: Add a Mortality event for GOAT-003
Open Livestock and edit GOAT-003 status to Dead
expected: GOAT-003 remains listed as Dead and the mortality event remains visible.

name: Reject incomplete animal
description: Verifies required animal identification fields block incomplete saves.
steps: Leave Tag, Breed and Date of birth empty
expected: The form blocks the save and shows required-field validation.
